_comment: Gzip budgets in KiB per route, measured from dist/ after `pnpm build` (docs/05, ADR-009). Raise a number only with a reason in the PR. Measured when set: js 86, css 14, html 8. `js` is what the route loads up front; `lazy` is everything behind a dynamic import() and defaults to 0, so a route that starts lazy-loading JS (the ADR-007 WebGL hero) has to declare the cost in `overrides` instead of it going unmeasured.
